teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: cut, cook, mix, boil, bake, fry, add, recipe, ingredient, salt, pepper, oil

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
cut, cook, mix, boil, bake, fry, add, recipe, ingredient, salt, pepper, oil
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• First, cut the vegetables into small pieces (step 1)
• Add salt and pepper to taste (seasoning)
• Mix everything in a big bowl (combining)
• Bake in the oven for thirty minutes (cooking time)
Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of /aɪ/ in 'recipe' /ˈres.ə.pi/ and 'ingredient' /ɪnˈɡriː.di.ənt/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Imperatives for Recipe Steps ('Cut the tomatoes', 'Mix the ingredients', 'Boil for 10 minutes')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Imperatives for Recipe Steps ('Cut the tomatoes', 'Mix the ingredients', 'Boil for 10 minutes')
Controlled Practice:
You divide a tomato into small pieces with a knife. What action verb is this?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: How do you make fresh tomato salad?
B: It is very easy! First, cut four tomatoes and one cucumber.
A: Do I add oil?
B: Yes, add olive oil, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a chef giving step-by-step instructions for cooking a pasta dish and put the steps in order.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can explain basic cooking steps and list ingredients for a simple recipe.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can explain basic cooking steps and list ingredients for a simple recipe.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
